capabilities: Toggle a focus session anchored to the current note via ribbon icon or command
Show a warning banner when a different note is opened
Auto-dismiss the banner after a configurable delay or close it manually
Customize the banner message and dismissal timeout in settings
disambiguation: Not a distraction-free writing mode; it only shows a banner when you navigate to a different note during an active session.
extras: Installation is manual: copy main.js, manifest.json and styles.css into the vault's plugins folder; the author notes it was vibe coded using Claude.
motivation: The author describes opening a note with a clear intention, then following links until forgetting what you were doing, and built the plugin to make that drift visible and deliberate.
problem: Following links between notes makes it easy to drift away from the note you opened with a clear intention, losing track of what you were doing.
summary: Navigation guard that toggles a focus session and shows a warning banner whenever you open a note other than the one you started on.
